subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: Strengthen FR-8/FR-9 so policy fetches and claim transport use runner-owned Git storage before launch; only the winner receives a private independent clone for edits, tests, and supervisor-owned publication. Preserve the enrolled checkout's files, branch, index, configuration, and refs.
rationale: A job modifying code or raising a PR outside its own worktree “can cause issue”.
